items.title: Kering Q2 results: Gucci's sales decline narrows, CEO Bellettini admits brand went too far on price in some categories
items.summary: Bloomberg's report on Kering's H1 2026 results notes Gucci CEO Francesca Bellettini and group CEO Luca de Meo acknowledged the brand had been "repositioned... because in some categories we went too far" on pricing, framed by analysts as a correction of prior greedflation. Comparable sales fell 2% in Q2, beating the roughly 3-4% decline expected, aided by early resonance of Demna's first designs, especially in the US; still the group's 12th straight quarterly Gucci decline. This pricing-admission angle continues to circulate in EU trade commentary this week as the substantive read on Gucci's European price strategy going forward.

items.title: Kering H1 2026: group back to comparable growth, Western Europe still down 7%
items.summary: Official Kering investor release confirms group H1 revenue of EUR 7.22bn (+1% comparable), Gucci H1 revenue of EUR 2.75bn (down 9% reported, 5% comparable), while Western Europe -7% remained the weakest region versus North America. Jewellery (+18%) and Eyewear (+8%) offset Gucci's continued drag. Primary source still actively cited by EU trade press this week as the baseline for Gucci's regional performance narrative in Europe.

items.title: Kering continues to reduce Gucci dependence as store rationalisation proceeds toward 100 net closures in 2026
items.summary: Trade coverage recaps Kering's ongoing 'ReconKering' rationalisation: 84 net store closures completed group-wide in H1 2026 against a full-year target of 100, roughly 40 percent of them Gucci outlet/discount locations, part of a plan to refurbish or relocate two-thirds of the Gucci store network and cut selling space 20 percent by 2030. Frames Gucci's European retail footprint as still shrinking even as headline sales stabilise, a structurally critical angle on the brand's on-the-ground presence.

items.title: Italian supply-chain groups urge Gucci not to abandon Sud Salento footwear supplier amid order cuts
items.summary: Italian trade outlet reports continued pressure on Gucci from local industry and union groups in Puglia over reduced orders to supplier Sud Salento srl, which produces footwear components exclusively for Kering/Gucci and has already moved through collective-dismissal procedures affecting roughly 120 of 335 workers. Coverage frames the episode as an ongoing supply-chain casualty of Gucci's SKU-reduction and cost-discipline strategy, a critical labour/local-economy angle distinct from headline financial recovery narrative.

items.title: Must Read roundup: Gucci beats forecasts as US and European tourism drive Hermes and luxury sector sales
items.summary: Cross-brand trade digest situates Gucci's smaller-than-feared Q2 decline within a broader luxury-sector picture where American and European tourist spending is propping up flagship categories; notes analysts remain cautious that a single better quarter does not yet confirm a durable Gucci turnaround. Useful for regional-context framing of Gucci against peers rather than Gucci-only reporting.

items.title: Kering shares surge as much as 15-17% on Gucci turnaround momentum; HSBC upgrades to buy
items.summary: WWD financial report on the market reaction to Kering's Q2 print: shares jumped as much as 15-17 percent intraday, HSBC upgraded Kering to 'buy' and raised its price target to EUR340 from EUR290, citing Gucci's narrowing comparable decline as the first sign the de Meo/Bellettini turnaround plan is gaining real traction with investors, though several desks flagged the move as partly a relief rally after several quarters of disappointment.

items.title: French-language Trustpilot reviews of gucci.com remain dominated by delivery and after-sales complaints
items.summary: Continuing rolling review stream (roughly 1,700+ total reviews on the storefront) shows persistent complaints this month about delayed or lost parcels, denied returns, and refusal of repair or compensation for items judged defective shortly after purchase, alongside a smaller share of positive in-boutique service reports. Unverified-purchaser community reviews, treated strictly as an opinion thermometer per source-pool policy, not a scientific sample.

items.title: PurseForum Gucci Clubhouse members split on whether Demna-era bag pricing matches perceived quality
items.summary: Active collector-forum threads in the Gucci Clubhouse continue debating whether reissued archival styles (Flora, Bamboo, Jackie) justify current price points; several posters compare craftsmanship unfavourably to Bottega Veneta and Loewe at similar price tiers, while others defend the brand's heritage value and praise recent leather quality. Legitimate fandom/collector volume, magnitude-damped per sentiment rubric rather than read as scientific opinion.

items.title: Retail-investor and fashion-commentary posts on X continue debating whether Gucci's Q2 beat is a real turnaround
items.summary: Public X posts tagged around Kering/Gucci earnings split between investor accounts citing the HSBC upgrade and narrowing sales decline as bullish, and fashion commentators skeptical that one quarter offsets three years of decline and repeated store closures; several posts specifically reference the CEO's admission that pricing "went too far" as vindication of long-standing consumer complaints. Individual post-level reach/engagement not independently verifiable via public search; recorded as directional volume only.

items.title: Analysis: Gucci seemingly on the cusp of a turnaround, but H1 results still show a house not yet out of the woods
items.summary: FashionNetwork analysis piece argues Kering CEO Luca de Meo's ReconKering plan appears to have set Gucci on the right track after the narrower-than-feared Q2 comparable decline, while cautioning that H1 2026 group profit and Gucci revenue both remain well down versus prior years and that investors are pricing in a recovery that has not yet fully materialised in the numbers. Balanced trade-press read that neither fully credits nor dismisses the turnaround narrative building in Europe.
